scientific_assessment.reason: Scored on probe agents the ABM never simulated, field-wide tree and MLP policies learn interaction structure a linear policy cannot, in every visibility regime. The v3 geometry crossover survives: the MLP wins the smooth world and the tree wins the axis world. Neighbor-scale evidence makes every feature learner worse than the fixed prior. Learning changes who enters only when failure is visible at once. From a two-step delay on, every field arm enters every agent. Raw entry precision follows the crossover, but only the tree passes the interaction-specific DiD, because the MLP also gains in the linear world.
